entries.source_quote: Periodically, Aatrox empowers his next basic attack to ... deal bonus magic damage equal to 4% : 8% (based on level) of the target's maximum health, capped at 100 against monsters.

The beam will deal a burst of bonus magic damage for each full second that it damages the same enemy ... The damage based on the target's health ratio is capped at 300 against monsters. (Passive: Bursts deal bonus magic damage based on the target's maximum health.)
The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage equal to 2.5% (+ 2% per 100 AP) of the target's maximum health, capped at 100 : 270 (based on level) against monsters.

If the target is an enemy, she deals magic damage ... and reduces their armor and magic resistance for 5 seconds. (Resistances Reduction: 10% / 12.5% / 15% / 17.5% / 20%)
Enemies hit by the outer half of the cone take additional physical damage, capped at 300 against monsters. (Outer Cone Bonus Damage target_max_hp_pct 6.0 / 6.5 / 7.0 / 7.5 / 8.0%)

the gusts form a tornado ... dealing magic damage equal to 2.5% (+ 1% per 100 AP) of target's maximum health every 0.5 seconds [10% over the duration] ... capped at 150 per tick / 600 total against monsters
